mapper.sql: SELECT g.id, g.destination_id, g.author_id, g.title, g.summary, g.cover_image_url, g.location_text, g.scope, g.travel_mode, g.published_at, g.days, g.budget_total, g.views_count, g.likes_count, g.comments_count, g.favorites_count, g.status, d.name AS destination_name, up.nickname AS author_name, up.avatar_url AS author_avatar_url
FROM guides g LEFT JOIN destinations d ON d.id = g.destination_id LEFT JOIN user_profiles up ON up.user_id = g.author_id
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM guides WHERE publish_status = 'published' AND destination_id = #{destinationId}
SELECT id, guide_id, day_no, title, summary, sort_order FROM guide_itinerary_days WHERE guide_id = #{guideId} ORDER BY day_no ASC
SELECT id, guide_id, category_name, sort_order FROM guide_tips WHERE guide_id = #{guideId} ORDER BY sort_order ASC
SELECT id, guide_id, category_code, category_name, amount, percentage, sort_order FROM guide_budget_items WHERE guide_id = #{guideId} ORDER BY sort_order ASC

SELECT g2.id, g2.title, g2.cover_image_url, d.name AS destination_name FROM guide_related gr JOIN guides g2 ON g2.id = gr.related_guide_id LEFT JOIN destinations d ON d.id = g2.destination_id WHERE gr.guide_id = #{guideId} AND g2.publish_status = 'published' ORDER BY gr.sort_order ASC LIMIT #{limit}

WHERE g.publish_status = 'published' AND (g.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') OR g.summary LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') OR g.content_html LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%')) ORDER BY g.likes_count DESC, g.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
